lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The pattern exhibits a structured grid-like distribution in the mid-lateral zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a localized rectangular grid pattern posterior to the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally along the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with higher luminance above the ridge line and shadow-dominant lower luminance below.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of smaller high-luminance blobs concentrated along the anterior edge and distal portion of the fin surface.
